title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
abstract: arXiv:2611.22252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis.   Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema. A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only.   Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall

translated_title: 基于多模态大语言模型的扫描式认知与行为评估视觉信息提取系统
translated_abstract: 目标。纸质评估在患者护理中十分常见，但手写字迹和扫描伪影使这些表格难以大规模处理。本研究提出了一种模块化、基于多模态大语言模型（LLM）并带有人工监督的系统，用于提取字段和分数。我们对使用大语言模型进行手绘分析进行了定性研究。材料与方法。该系统通过两个模块处理认知评估（即MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog）和NICHQ Vanderbilt评估：1）表单分类器，将扫描页面归类为相应的表单类型；2）对应的分数提取器，将字段和分数提取到预定义的模式（schema）中。系统采用基于双模型验证的人机协同（human-in-the-loop）设计，仅当两个大语言模型的输出不一致时才引入人工标注员，从而将人工审核限定于具有挑战性的页面。结果。认知评估的端到端准确率为88%，大多数表单类型的准确率超过90%。对于NICHQ Vanderbilt评估，整体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于多模态大语言模型的模块化信息提取系统，通过表单分类器、分数提取器以及双模型验证的人机协同设计，从扫描的手写认知与行为评估表中高效提取字段和分数，认知评估端到端准确率达88%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a modular multimodal LLM-based visual information extraction system with dual-model human-in-the-loop validation that accurately extracts fields and scores from scanned handwritten cognitive and behavioral assessments, achieving 88% end-to-end accuracy.
